claims.statement: The fragment directs subscription comparison through pricing and selection of an upgrade. It is a conditional UI procedure, not a universal requirement to purchase, current price evidence or proof an account was created.

The fragment offers dedicated classic tokens per account with repo scope or fine-grained tokens per account/organization for desired repositories with content read/write permissions. These are parent-task-specific prerequisites, not universal least-privilege requirements for read-only collection; exact task, repository access, approvals and token type must be resolved before credential creation.

Deleting an account can permanently retire the owner/repository-name pair for public repositories containing a Marketplace-listed action or exceeding 100 clones or 100 Actions uses in the preceding week. Strict greater-than thresholds and the public scope are retained; this caveat is not authority to delete or a guarantee of name reuse below thresholds.
